title: Propose typed semantic authoring ergonomics loop
summary: The project owner asked Codex to record its typed semantic authoring recommendations and propose a forced long loop. The resulting proposal prioritizes low-boilerplate defaults and semantic templates, keeps matrices as compatible basis-dependent representations, tests internal linear-map and law-evidence capabilities, and requires explicit approval before execution.
